about: Labelled cases for /orchestrate. facts feed skills/orchestrate/route.py (unit tests); request and readme feed the live run (tests/live/orchestrate/run.py). expect is the route; accept lists other routes that also pass; risk high adds check k-9. stubs are placeholder files the live run creates, as path pattern ({n} = 1..count) to count. stub_bytes, when set, pads each placeholder file to that size, so a case about bulky reading has bulk to read (round 8: 17-byte placeholders made 60 services fit in one context).
